WarningSystem__GlobalConfig.WarningSystem__GlobalConfig__Description: Global settings for the data-driven warning system. PanelCountMap maps door-type strings to panel/leaf counts. 'FromAssembly' means the count is read from the assembly data (e.g. bifold configurator output). DefaultPanelCount is the fallback when a door type is absent from the map.
WarningSystem__GlobalConfig.WarningSystem__GlobalConfig__HingeProjec: 8-inch hinge projection is non-standard and requires senior architect approval before specification. Confirm to proceed or cancel to select a different projection.
WarningSystem__GlobalConfig.WarningSystem__GlobalConfig__HeightMisma: Assembly heights differ by more than 15 mm. Mismatched door heights on the same elevation may cause visual inconsistency. Review before finalising.

DocumentWarning.Title: Door Panel Width Warning
DocumentWarning.Message: One or more door panels exceed 1050 mm width. Subject to approval by Senior Technical Manager.

WarningSystem__Rules.EditorNotification: Panel over 1000 mm wide requires double-top hinge arrangement. Subject to review — may require double-top and double-bottom (5 hinges total) or a pivot system.

DocumentWarning.Title: Wide Leaf Hinge Review

WarningSystem__Rules.EditorNotification: Bifold leaf is wider than 1000 mm. Are you sure this configuration is correct?

DocumentWarning.Title: Bifold Panel Width Warning
DocumentWarning.Message: One or more bifold leaves exceed 1000 mm width. Verify the panel configuration is intentional.

WarningSystem__Rules.EditorNotification: Doors above 2400 mm height require non-standard hinge specification.

DocumentWarning.Title: Door Height Warning

WarningSystem__Rules.EditorNotification: Extreme door height — doors above 2650 mm are a special case and require written approval from a Senior Architect before specification. Do not proceed without confirmation.

DocumentWarning.Title: Extreme Door Height — Special Approval Required
DocumentWarning.Message: Door height exceeds 2650 mm. This is an extreme specification and requires written approval from a Senior Architect prior to order. Ensure approval is documented before finalising.

WarningSystem__Rules.EditorNotification: Tall single doors may benefit from an additional top bolt for security. Subject to senior review.

WarningSystem__Rules.EditorNotification: 8-inch hinge projection is non-standard and requires senior architect approval.

DocumentWarning.Message: 8-inch hinge projection is non-standard and requires senior architect approval before specification.

WarningSystem__Rules.EditorNotification: The Handle Type for this assembly is different to the others on the project.

DocumentWarning.Message: The Handle Type for this assembly is different to the others on the project.

WarningSystem__Rules.EditorNotification: Selected hardware includes non-complementary items. Ensure the client is quoted, invoiced, and aware of cost upgrades prior to order.

DocumentWarning.Title: Cost Upgrade Warning
DocumentWarning.Message: Selected hardware includes non-complementary items. Confirm quotation and client approval for upgraded costs before ordering.

WarningSystem__Rules.EditorNotification: Motorised window selected — standard hardware generation is overridden.

DocumentWarning.Title: Motorised Window Override
DocumentWarning.Message: Motorised window selected. Standard hardware and fastener generation has been overridden.

WarningSystem__Rules.EditorNotification: Isolated window — fastener inclusion is overridden throughout configuration.

DocumentWarning.Title: Isolated Window Override

WarningSystem__Rules.EditorNotification: Narrow top hung casement over 850 mm tall requires 2x fasteners.

DocumentWarning.Title: Top Hung Fastener Warning
DocumentWarning.Message: Top hung casement is narrower than 650 mm and taller than 850 mm. 2x fasteners are required.

WarningSystem__Rules.EditorNotification: Sash window over 800 mm wide requires 2x sliding sash fasteners.

DocumentWarning.Title: Sash Window Fastener Warning
DocumentWarning.Message: Sash window exceeds 800 mm width. 2x sliding sash fasteners are required per instance.
